summary: Iteration 142: QA of the premium black + blood-red theme across the site, plus the 2 targeted backend follow-ups from 141. BACKEND: 45/45 passed, all in the foreground with no bridge running. 141 API isolated 13/13 (updated and new cases below). 141 perf/guard 13/13 (the 2 heavy cases, baseline and all-10-papers, were deselected as the request asked). 140 guards 7/7. 139 suite 12/12. FRONTEND: tested through the isolated bridge on port 8791 with synthetic header users s/o/w; the customer DB was not touched; storage PUTs []. Landing, /login, /owner-login and /home at 1920x800 and 390x844: html.dark, body #08080A, light text, header rgba(8,8,10,.92) with no white box, the real SVG logo loads (13.7KB, 29 paths, no <image>/base64/<text>), favicon is the 512 crimson PNG, no ThemeToggle in the UI, and a stored theme='light' (theme, tejas-theme, jeelive-theme keys) does not revert the theme. JEE Main PYQ flow: years 2026/2025 and 10 January/April date tabs (active is white on #D91222, 5.17:1); 22 Jan S1 preflight shows the progress copy and passes in 4.86s; Start opens the real 75-question player; the source canvas parent is white with filter none; key '2' saves; 4 answers saved; the submit dialog submits; results load. Results: all 5 views click through (Analysis, Progress, Confidence, Real-exam rank, Solutions). Selected result view and selected Physics/Chemistry/Maths tabs are white on #D91222 (5.17:1, 13px). Solution numbers, aria-current Q39 and the bonus/withdrawn/key-only notice ('Full credit — source question withdrawn', +4) all work. Results filters pass contrast (about 8.2:1). The Source detail enlarge dialog is white with black ink and no inversion. Analytics workspace subtabs (ledger/offline/overview) and the ledger filter input work. Sticky nav does not cover the target after a number click on desktop (result-destinations sticky 183-251, card at 695) or mobile (only the 77px header is sticky). Mobile horizontal overflow is 0 on every page checked: series hub, exams, BITSAT/COMEDK mocks (empty in the isolated DB), chapters, results hub, profile/my-tests, saved drafts, competitions, studio, privacy, 404, set detail and player. The mobile player shows a white canvas, and the numeric input is themed and saves. The account dropdown menu is readable and its focused item is #2E1418 with white text. Owner studio and the editor's 5 tabs render. No pre-submit answer, key or bonus leak in the attempt API (bonus null on all 75, no accepted_answers/s_refs/rect). Main issues: (1) hover feedback on inactive result-view, solution-subject and exam-destination tabs is lost because older rules out-rank the final hover rule; (2) the confirm dialog's 'Go back' is painted primary red, the same as 'Submit & see results'; (3) the owner Studio page loads 7 parallel /api/studio GETs but the 'control' admission lane limit is 4, so some return 503 capacity_busy and the page shows Retry. Item (3) is likely pre-existing and not caused by the theme.

minor.issue: AdmissionGate 'control' lane INFLIGHT limit is 4 (tejas/runtime.py), but the Studio landing fires 7 concurrent studio GETs (sets, imports, chapter-books, mock-books, ai-review, solve-tests, question-report-priorities). Reproduced with 7 parallel curls: 3 returned 503 capacity_busy. In the browser the Studio sections show 'Retry'. Fix: raise the control limit, serialize/batch the frontend calls, or auto-retry honouring Retry-After. Likely pre-existing, not a theme regression.
Returns 503 capability_held in the isolated bridge, so the Studio editor shows 'This source image did not load'. This looks like the deliberate operator safety hold, not a theme bug. FYI only.

ui_bugs.component: Results view tabs, solution subject tabs, exam-destination links (hover)
ui_bugs.issue: The final rule at vibrant-ui.css line 203 (hover: #28131A bg, white text, #94303E border) never wins. Inactive result-view/subject tabs at rest are #14141C with #B0B0BF text. On hover they go to #0F0F14 (darker, almost invisible) with the text unchanged. Exam-destination links ('Chapter tests', 'My results') do not change at all on hover (color-mix values stay). Older, higher-specificity rules win, e.g. '.dark:not(.exam-light) .jeelive-tabs [role=tab].jeelive-tab:not([data-state=active])' at specificity 0,6,0 against 0,5,0 for the hover rule, and the learning-workspace .result-destinations [role=tab] rules. The hover state is effectively missing.

'Go back' (data-testid=confirm-cancel, class btn btn-secondary) is computed #D91222 with white text, the same as the destructive/final 'Submit & see results' (confirm-accept). There is no visual hierarchy on a final-submit dialog. Probable cause: the Button has no variant, so it gets data-ui-variant='default' and the '.jeelive-button[data-ui-variant=default]' override paints it red. Other pages' btn-secondary buttons were not red.

integration_issues.issue: Some studio list calls fail with 503 capacity_busy (see backend minor) and show a Retry UI. The 'Retry' text is #D91222 on #14141C, which is 3.54:1 and below 4.5:1.

issues: The 'You' legend label is #D91222 on #14141C (3.54:1, small text). Use --brand-text #FF6974. 'Average' is exactly 4.50:1 (#9B7380), which is borderline.
The not-found card spans the full viewport width (x 0-390) with no side gutter, unlike other pages, which use 20px.
After typing in player-numerical-input, the field stays partly under the sticky bottom Previous/Next bar. Consider scroll-padding-bottom or scrollIntoView when the input is focused.

The traced tagline 'SCORE 200+ WITH AI' and the emblem edges show small potrace notches/irregular strokes at large sizes (visible at 700px width). At header size this is acceptable. The 'emblem' linearGradient in the SVG <defs> is unused (the emblem is solid #EF3445). The wordmark fill #FAF7F5 is near-white, so the SVG is invisible on any white surface; this is fine while the theme is always dark, but avoid reusing the SVG on light/print/OG surfaces.
src/components/ThemeToggle.js (reads/writes tejas-theme) and the exam-light.css import in App.js remain as dead code; nothing renders them.

action_items: Restore hover feedback on inactive result-view, solution-subject and exam-destination tabs: raise the specificity of the final hover rule (e.g. add the '.dark:not(.exam-light)' prefix or a :is() wrapper) so it beats the inactive rules; verify the computed values change on hover.

Make ConfirmDialog's confirm-cancel a real secondary/outline variant (pass variant='outline' or exclude .btn-secondary from the default-variant override) so 'Go back' is not the same red as 'Submit & see results'.

Owner Studio: avoid 7 concurrent control-lane requests against INFLIGHT control=4 (raise the limit, stagger the requests, or auto-retry on 503 Retry-After). Also make the 'Retry' text use --brand-text for contrast.
Results chart legend 'You': use #FF6974 (or another colour at 4.5:1 or more) instead of #D91222 for small text.
Low: add a side gutter to the 404 card on mobile; keep the focused numeric input above the sticky player bar; remove the dead ThemeToggle.js and exam-light.css import; drop the unused SVG gradient.
critical_code_review_comments: derivatives.py: _validation_locks is now a separate Lock list from _locks (asset render). The validation path only calls get_object/validate_pdf/_render_crop_png and never takes _locks, so there is no lock-order deadlock. Coalescing holds: 4 concurrent cold = 1 GET.

attempts.py preflight: CanonicalIntegrityError is caught before ValueError in the PYQ branch, so it gives an honest 503 ('original source could not be verified ... timer has not started'). Non-PYQ still goes through validate_refs and returns 400 (unchanged, as requested). Consider a Retry-After header on this 503 for clients.

vibrant-ui.css appends override layers. Many old selectors carry '.dark:not(.exam-light)' prefixes and win over the new final rules, so interaction states silently fail. A specificity audit for :hover/:focus-visible states is recommended.

Setting every --ui-green/--ui-amber/--ui-cyan/--learn-blue token to #D91222 is intentional for tab accents. Semantic status colours (--success/--warning/--danger) remain green/amber/pink and are used correctly in solution numbers and legend.

success_rate.frontend: about 90% (all core flows work; 2 medium visual-state issues; Studio 503 partially pre-existing)

test_credentials: No credentials used or created. Synthetic X-Test-User header users only (s/o/w) via the 139 harness bridge; owner is a synthetic role fixture.
seed_data_creation: Isolated DB tejas_isolated_iter134 only: 30 PYQ papers imported by the bridge; 3 TEST attempts (s on 22 Jan S1 submitted; o on 22 Jan S2 and S1 active). The DB was dropped at stop (DROPPED True, DB absent afterwards). Storage PUTs [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: In test_iter141_preflight_api_isolated.py: test_hash_mismatch_503_no_write now expects PYQ 503 (twice; each call does 1 GET, so the failure is not cached) with 'could not be verified' + 'timer has not started' and no 'coordinates'. Non-PYQ mock stays 400. No preflight record, no new attempt, and a recovery preflight returns 200 after the tamper is cleared (its record is deleted afterwards). The new test_validation_lock_distinct_from_asset_lock asserts no shared Lock objects, that render_crop completes while one validation stripe (and then all of them) is held, and that validation then proceeds. Run these suites in the foreground with -n0 -p no:cacheprovider and never while the bridge runs. Browser bridge routing: page.route('**/api/**') -> route.fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8791'+path, headers + x-test-user). For owner pages, limit concurrency with an asyncio.Semaphore(2-3) to avoid the 503 capacity_busy control lane. Stop the bridge with pkill -INT -f iso_bridge_pyq_iter139.py so it prints DROPPED True. BITSAT/COMEDK mocks, the series hub and chapters show empty states only (no fixtures in the isolated DB).
rca of the issue: Tab hover: the final hover rule has specificity 0,5,0; legacy inactive rules such as '.dark:not(.exam-light) .jeelive-tabs [role=tab].jeelive-tab:not([data-state=active])' are 0,6,0, and the result-destinations rules exist too, so the hover background/colour never apply. Confirm cancel red: the shadcn Button defaults to data-ui-variant='default', which the global primary override targets regardless of the .btn-secondary class. Studio 503: tejas/admission.py rejects a request when lane in_flight >= limit (control=4), and the Studio landing issues 7 at once.
